name: Jobs Data MCP (SteadyScrape)
description: Live job postings collected from employers' own career sites (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, SmartRecruiters, Workable and more), plus keyword job search and remote-eligibility search by country, region or time zone. Three tools served through Apify's hosted MCP gateway; results are billed per job on the user's own Apify account.
author: steadyscrape
